justification: Minimal repair replaces the bare EL verb with its morphologically integrated infinitive form. The 'vamos a + infinitive' frame forces the infinitive shape uniquely; no tense ambiguity.

provenance.review_disagreement: Independent blind reviewer repaired to 'Vamos a taggear la foto.' -- an attested alternate integration spelling of the same loanword (double-g preserving the English /g/ before the -ear suffix), not a different construction. Added as alternate_repairs rather than treated as an error, matching the precedent already set for cliquea/clickea in the pilot set.
